q.line: Umpa, umpa, stick it up your jumper
stanza: Umpa, umpa, stick it up your jumper
Everybody's got one, everybody's got one
If ever thou wilt thrive, bury my Body
And give the Letters which thou findst about me

“I know thee well, a serviceable Villain; as duteous to the Vices of thy Mistre…
